$comment: The web tier's golden hash fixtures (AGENTS.md § 4: reviewed like source).
Each entry records output_sha256 for one golden-seeds.json matchup over
the full 1500-tick run. A hash that changes without a deliberate
sim_version or balance bump fails the build; a hash edited by hand to
make a build pass is the failure mode this file cannot prevent.
To record or re-record: run pnpm test and copy the hash from the
golden gate's failure message into hashes/<matchup id>.
balance_version_id and balance_sha256 pin the balance these hashes
were recorded under: the parsed parts catalog (robot/parts.ts PARTS)
